condo: Highest rental yield in District 3, city fringe, ideal for ownstay and investment

history.summary: Generic-titled 99-yr 2BR (700sqft) at a steep $2,600 PSF / $1.82M, 270m from Outram Park MRT (a triple-line interchange: NEL/EWL/TEL) in D3. The location is excellent for rental, but $2,600 PSF on a 99-yr lease is full premium pricing with no built_year and no URA data to verify the project or trend.
history.rating_rationale: Outram Park is one of the best-connected MRT nodes in Singapore (270m, triple interchange) right on the city/GSW fringe, so the rental thesis is real and the $1.82M sits in the liquid band. But $2,600 PSF is aggressive for a 99-yr 2BR, the missing built_year and absent URA series mean lease/age and trend are unverified, and the listing title is marketing rather than a known project. Strong location, unproven value — Neutral.
